description: Trigger evals for the apm-lifecycle-tests dispatch description. 10 should-trigger + 10 near-miss should-NOT-trigger. 60/40 train/val split. Validation split is the ship gate (>=0.5 on should-trigger AND <0.5 on should-not-trigger).

notes: Unit and component tests of one function do not trigger even when they touch lifecycle-adjacent modules.
PR review of test coverage belongs to the test-coverage-expert persona, not this skill.
Deciding which tests to delete is out of scope; migration with moves or merges does trigger.
CI plumbing and harness docstring edits do not trigger; authoring a test against the real CLI does.
